mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_oauth_client (client_id, client_name, issuer_uri, resource_uri, product_code, source_code, connector_code, redirect_port, redirect_uri, token_endpoint_auth_method, grant_types_canonical, response_types_canonical, scope_canonical, scope_digest, metadata_digest, registration_source_digest, status, registered_at, expires_at, terminated_at, version) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{clientName}, #{issuerUri}, #{resourceUri}, #{productCode}, #{sourceCode}, #{connectorCode}, #{redirectPort}, #{redirectUri}, #{tokenEndpointAuthMethod}, #{grantTypesCanonical}, #{responseTypesCanonical}, #{scopeCanonical}, #{scopeDigest}, #{metadataDigest}, #{registrationSourceDigest}, #{status}, #{registeredAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{terminatedAt}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_client WHERE client_id = #{clientId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE fbs_oauth_client SET status = #{targetStatus}, terminated_at = #{terminatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_oauth_authorization_request (request_handle_digest, client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge, code_challenge_method, state_digest, state_key_ref, state_nonce, state_ciphertext, issuer_uri, resource_uri, product_code, source_code, connector_code, scope_canonical, scope_digest, enterprise_id, member_id, user_id, principal_subject_digest, status, requested_at, expires_at, approved_at, denied_at, consumed_at, version) VALUES (#{requestHandleDigest}, #{clientId}, #{redirectUri}, #{codeChallenge}, #{codeChallengeMethod}, #{stateDigest}, #{stateKeyRef}, #{stateNonce}, #{stateCiphertext}, #{issuerUri}, #{resourceUri}, #{productCode}, #{sourceCode}, #{connectorCode}, #{scopeCanonical}, #{scopeDigest}, #{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{userId}, #{principalSubjectDigest}, #{status}, #{requestedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{approvedAt}, #{deniedAt}, #{consumedAt}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_authorization_request WHERE request_handle_digest = #{requestHandleDigest} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE fbs_oauth_authorization_request SET enterprise_id = #{request.tenantId}, member_id = #{request.memberId}, user_id = #{request.userId}, principal_subject_digest = #{request.principalSubjectDigest}, status = 'DENIED', denied_at = #{request.deniedAt}, state_key_ref = NULL, state_nonce = NULL, state_ciphertext = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{request.id} AND client_id = #{request.clientId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > #{request.deniedAt}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_oauth_authorization_code (code_digest, authorization_request_id, client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge, code_challenge_method, issuer_uri, resource_uri, product_code, source_code, connector_code, scope_canonical, scope_digest, enterprise_id, member_id, user_id, principal_subject_digest, status, issued_at, expires_at, used_at, revoked_at, version) VALUES (#{codeDigest}, #{authorizationRequestId}, #{clientId}, #{redirectUri}, #{codeChallenge}, #{codeChallengeMethod}, #{issuerUri}, #{resourceUri}, #{productCode}, #{sourceCode}, #{connectorCode}, #{scopeCanonical}, #{scopeDigest}, #{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{userId}, #{principalSubjectDigest}, #{status}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{usedAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_authorization_code WHERE code_digest = #{codeDigest} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_oauth_token_family (family_id, origin_authorization_code_id, client_id, enterprise_id, member_id, user_id, product_code, source_code, connector_code, issuer_uri, resource_uri, scope_canonical, scope_digest, principal_subject_digest, binding_id, binding_version, status, current_refresh_generation, issued_at, activated_at, expires_at, terminated_at, version) VALUES (#{familyId}, #{originAuthorizationCodeId}, #{clientId}, #{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{userId}, #{productCode}, #{sourceCode}, #{connectorCode}, #{issuerUri}, #{resourceUri}, #{scopeCanonical}, #{scopeDigest}, #{principalSubjectDigest}, #{bindingId}, #{bindingVersion}, #{status}, #{currentRefreshGeneration}, #{issuedAt}, #{activatedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{terminatedAt}, #{version})
mapper.update: UPDATE fbs_oauth_token_family SET status = #{targetStatus}, terminated_at = #{terminatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('PENDING_BINDING', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_oauth_token (token_digest, family_id, token_type, generation, resource_uri, scope_canonical, scope_digest, status, issued_at, used_at, revoked_at, expires_at, version) VALUES (#{tokenDigest}, #{familyId}, #{tokenType}, #{generation}, #{resourceUri}, #{scopeCanonical}, #{scopeDigest}, #{status}, #{issuedAt}, #{usedAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_token WHERE family_id = #{familyId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE fbs_oauth_token SET status = CASE WHEN expires_at <= #{revokedAt} THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'REVOKED' END, revoked_at = CASE WHEN expires_at <= #{revokedAt} THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(issued_at, #{revokedAt}) END, version = version + 1 WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_oauth_receipt (receipt_id, action, client_id, authorization_request_id, authorization_code_id, family_id, token_id, binding_id, enterprise_id, member_id, user_id, principal_subject_digest, actor_type, actor_user_id, actor_subject_digest, correlation_id, payload_digest, evidence_level, created_at) VALUES (#{receiptId}, #{action}, #{clientId}, #{authorizationRequestId}, #{authorizationCodeId}, #{familyId}, #{tokenId}, #{bindingId}, #{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{userId}, #{principalSubjectDigest}, #{actorType}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorSubjectDigest}, #{correlationId}, #{payloadDigest}, #{evidenceLevel}, #{createdAt})
